items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Implements exactly the fix webui#415 suggests: probe host now follows SHIPWRIGHT_NETWORK_PROFILE via the server's own resolveHonoHost, threaded through tcpOccupied, the diagnostics fetch, and the reported/opened url. No extra features added.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: resolveProbeHost wraps the dynamic import + resolveHonoHost() call in try/catch and falls back to 127.0.0.1 on any failure (missing build, tailscale CLI unreachable) — never fatal, matching the module's existing non-fatal contract.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user input, no SQL/HTML output, no secrets. The dynamically-imported path is built from pkgRoot (a trusted, process-controlled value, same as bootSpawnPlan already uses), not from any external input.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: New tests assert on outcomes (returned host string, threaded host/url values via injected spies), cover the happy path (concrete host, wildcard mapping) and the failure path (import throws, resolver throws) for resolveProbeHost, plus probeServer host-threading and ensureServer url-building with both a loopback and a non-loopback resolution.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One dynamic import + one function call per ensureServer invocation (a one-shot CLI command); no loops, no N+1, no blocking I/O beyond what already existed (the tcpProbe/fetch calls).

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New functions follow existing file conventions (JSDoc header, seam-injectable deps). bootstrapper/lib/server.mjs was already 369 lines (over the 300-line convention) before this diff and is not in shipwright_bloat_baseline.json (the baseline appears server/client-scoped, not bootstrapper/); this diff adds ~47 lines to a pre-existing over-ceiling file rather than newly crossing a tracked baseline. A structural split is out of scope for this small bug fix and is left as a follow-up, not silently absorbed here.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized/on-disk format changed (no new file format, no schema). This changes network addressing (which host is probed/reported), not a producer/consumer data format, so round-trip probes do not apply.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: uv run shared/scripts/tools/scan_test_hygiene.py --diff reported no findings against the changed test file.
